_note: Chapter 06 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: The new government decided to abolish the old tax on imported books.
ex.cn: 新政府决定废除对进口图书征收的旧税。
ex.note: abolish a system / law / tax 废除某项制度、法律或税种

ex.en: The accountant checks our expenses at the end of every month.
ex.cn: 会计在每个月月底核查我们的开支。
ex.note: a company accountant 公司会计；an independent accountant 独立审计师

ex.en: Write your name and address clearly on the front of the form.
ex.cn: 在表格正面清楚地写上你的姓名和地址。
ex.note: a home address 家庭住址；an opening address 开幕致辞

ex.en: She addressed the meeting for ten minutes before taking questions.
ex.cn: 她向与会者讲话十分钟，然后开始接受提问。
ex.note: address a problem 处理一个问题；address sb. as 称呼某人为

ex.en: The train was late, so we had to wait all over again.
ex.cn: 火车晚点了，我们又得从头等起。
ex.note: once again 再一次；and again 再者

ex.en: She walked alongside her brother along the river bank.
ex.cn: 她沿着河岸和弟弟并肩走着。
ex.note: alongside sb. 与某人并肩；alongside sth. 与某物并列

ex.en: The volunteers dressed as angels to welcome the children at the gate.
ex.cn: 志愿者们打扮成天使，在门口迎接孩子们。
ex.note: an angel of a person 心地善良的人

ex.en: It soon became apparent that the machine had been switched on.
ex.cn: 很快就明显看出，这台机器已经通电了。
ex.note: it is apparent that… 显而易见…；apparent to 对…而言显得

ex.en: The arithmetic in this report is wrong, so the total cannot be trusted.
ex.cn: 这份报告里的算术有误，所以总数靠不住。
ex.note: mental arithmetic 心算；simple arithmetic 简单的计算

ex.en: A third-year student offered to lend her notes to anyone who asked for assistance.
ex.cn: 一个三年级的学生主动提出，谁需要帮忙就借笔记给谁。
ex.note: with the assistance of 在…的协助下；financial assistance 经济援助

ex.en: Every Sunday my aunt cooks lunch for the whole family.
ex.cn: 每个星期天，我姑姑都为全家人做午饭。
ex.note: aunt 姑姑/姨母/伯母/婶母/舅母；uncle 是对应的男性称谓

ex.en: She lost her balance on the wet floor and fell.
ex.cn: 她在湿滑的地板上失去平衡，摔了一跤。
ex.note: lose one's balance 失去平衡；balance of payments 国际收支差额

ex.en: The new plan will help balance the club's income and expenses.
ex.cn: 这个新方案有助于让社团的收入和支出保持平衡。
ex.note: balance the books 结清账目；balance sth. against sth. 使…与…相抵

ex.en: He took a hot bath after a long day on the fishing boat.
ex.cn: 在渔船上忙了一整天后，他洗了个热水澡。
ex.note: take / have a bath 洗澡；a bath tub 浴缸

ex.en: The teacher praised the students' good behavior during the trip.
ex.cn: 老师表扬了学生们旅途中良好的表现。
ex.note: be on one's best behavior 表现得非常规矩；the behavior of animals 动物的习性

ex.en: I am reading a biography of the doctor who founded the hospital.
ex.cn: 我正在读一本传记，写的是创办那家医院的医生。
ex.note: a biography of… 一本…的传记；an authorized biography 授权传记

ex.en: We crossed the lake in a small wooden boat.
ex.cn: 我们乘一条小木船过湖。
ex.note: by boat 乘船；a fishing boat 渔船

ex.en: Reading before bed is said to help the brain relax.
ex.cn: 据说睡前阅读有助于大脑放松。
ex.note: the human brain 人脑；use one's brains 动脑筋

ex.en: The club has a small budget, so every member has to save carefully.
ex.cn: 社团预算不多，所以每个成员都得精打细算。
ex.note: on a tight budget 预算很紧；a budget of … …的预算

ex.en: They budgeted half of their savings for the trip abroad.
ex.cn: 他们把一半积蓄列作出国旅行的开支。
ex.note: budget for sth. 为某事做预算；budget sth. at sth. 把某项开支定在某个数额

ex.en: The bird escaped from its cage and flew over the garden.
ex.cn: 鸟儿从笼子里逃了出来，飞过花园上空。
ex.note: in a cage 关在笼中；a cage of wires 铁丝笼

ex.en: The farmer caged the frightened hen until the fox was gone.
ex.cn: 农夫把受惊的母鸡关进笼子，直到狐狸走开。
ex.note: cage sb. in / up 把某人关在笼中

ex.en: She began her career as a reporter and later became a novelist.
ex.cn: 她以记者身份开始职业生涯，后来成了小说家。
ex.note: a career in sth. …方面的职业生涯；a career in the making 正在形成的事业

ex.en: The village celebrated the harvest with music and dancing.
ex.cn: 村民们以音乐和舞蹈庆祝丰收。
ex.note: celebrate sth. with sth. 用…庆祝…；celebrate doing 赞美…

ex.en: She gave away her old books to a local charity.
ex.cn: 她把旧书捐给了当地一家慈善机构。
ex.note: charity begins at home 慈善始于自家；a charity walk 慈善徒步

ex.en: The choice of a university was the hardest decision of his first year.
ex.cn: 选哪一所大学，是他第一年中最难的决定。
ex.note: make a choice 做出选择；a wide choice of 各种各样的选择

ex.en: The potter shapes the wet clay with his bare hands.
ex.cn: 陶艺人用双手塑造湿软的黏土。
ex.note: made of clay 黏土制成的；clay soil 黏质土壤

ex.en: He dropped a coin into the box and heard it clink against the others.
ex.cn: 他往箱子里丢了一枚硬币，听见它和别的硬币叮当作响。
ex.note: a coin toss 抛硬币；two coins 两分钱

ex.en: Rice and wheat are the most important commodities in this region.
ex.cn: 稻米和小麦是这一带最重要的商品。
ex.note: a valuable commodity 贵重商品；commodity prices 大宗商品价格

ex.en: The collection comprises more than two hundred folk songs.
ex.cn: 这套收藏包含两百多首民歌。
ex.note: be comprised of = be composed of 由…组成

ex.en: The lights went out, and for a moment there was complete confusion in the hall.
ex.cn: 灯灭了，礼堂里一时间乱作一团。
ex.note: in confusion 混乱地；confusion about 对…的困惑

ex.en: The city has cut the consumption of electricity by ten per cent.
ex.cn: 这座城市的用电量减少了百分之十。
ex.note: consumption of fuel 燃料消耗；daily consumption 日常消耗量

ex.en: The two departments cooperated closely to finish the project on time.
ex.cn: 两个部门密切合作，按时完成了项目。
ex.note: cooperate with sb. 与某人合作；cooperate to do sth. 合作做某事

ex.en: The county has built three new libraries in the past five years.
ex.cn: 这个县在过去五年里新建了三座图书馆。
ex.note: county and city 城乡；a county official 县里的官员

ex.en: The next three days will be critical for the whole project.
ex.cn: 接下来的三天对整个项目至关重要。
ex.note: be critical to / for 对…至关重要；be critical of 批评…

ex.en: The road follows a sharp curve around the foot of the hill.
ex.cn: 这条路绕着山脚拐成一个急弯。
ex.note: a sharp curve 急弯；the learning curve 学习曲线

ex.en: The heat made the plastic cover curve downwards.
ex.cn: 高温使塑料盖向下弯曲。
ex.note: curve towards 朝…倾斜；the road curved 道路弯曲

ex.en: The film includes a deaf actor who plays the lead role.
ex.cn: 这部影片里有一位聋人演员饰演主角。
ex.note: be deaf to 对…充耳不闻；deaf and mute 又聋又哑

ex.en: It is hard to define happiness, but most people know it when they feel it.
ex.cn: 幸福很难下定义，但多数人感觉到时就知道了。
ex.note: define sth. as… 把…定义为…；a clearly defined term 界定清晰的术语

ex.en: Many English words derive from Latin.
ex.cn: 许多英语单词源于拉丁语。
ex.note: derive from 源自；derive a conclusion from 从…得出结论

ex.en: She dialed the number twice before someone answered.
ex.cn: 她拨了两遍号码才有人接。
ex.note: dial a number 拨号码；dial in 拨入

ex.en: Turn the dial until the pointer points at zero.
ex.cn: 转动表盘，直到指针指向零。
ex.note: a clock dial 钟面；a control dial 控制旋钮

ex.en: The children came back from the garden with dirty hands and shoes.
ex.cn: 孩子们从花园里回来，手和鞋上都沾着泥。
ex.note: a dirty trick 卑鄙的伎俩；dirty the water 弄脏水

ex.en: Salt dissolves quickly in warm water.
ex.cn: 盐在温水里很快溶解。
ex.note: dissolve into 溶入；be dissolved 解散

ex.en: Students donated books and pens to the village school.
ex.cn: 学生们向那所乡村学校捐了书和钢笔。
ex.note: donate sth. to sb. / sth. 把某物捐给某人或某机构

ex.en: Water dripped from the roof into an old bucket.
ex.cn: 水从屋顶滴进一只旧桶里。
ex.note: drip from 从…滴下；drip onto 滴在…上

ex.en: There was not a single drip of water left in the bottle.
ex.cn: 瓶子里一滴水也不剩了。
ex.note: a drip of coffee 一滴咖啡；the drip of the tap 龙头滴水声

ex.en: Her earnest voice convinced everyone in the room.
ex.cn: 她诚挚的语气说服了屋里的每一个人。
ex.note: an earnest student 认真的学生；in earnest 认真地

ex.en: They finished the race in eighth place.
ex.cn: 他们获得了赛跑的第八名。
ex.note: the eighth of … …的第八天；on the eighth day 在第八天

ex.en: He spoke with emotion about the town he had grown up in.
ex.cn: 他动情地谈起自己长大的那座小镇。
ex.note: with emotion 动情地；arouse emotion 激起情感

ex.en: We do not have enough time to finish the experiment today.
ex.cn: 我们没有足够的时间今天做完这个实验。
ex.note: enough + n. / adj. 足够…；n. / adj. + enough 足够地

ex.en: The establishment of the new club took less than a week.
ex.cn: 新社团的成立不到一个星期。
ex.note: a large establishment 一家大机构；the establishment of … …的建立

ex.en: Everyone came to the party except for two students who were ill.
ex.cn: 除了两个生病的学生，大家都来参加聚会了。
ex.note: except for 除…之外（整体中的例外）；except that 除了…（后接从句）

ex.en: The old balloon exploded with a loud bang.
ex.cn: 那个旧气球砰的一声炸开了。
ex.note: explode with anger 勃然大怒；explode into popularity 迅速走红

ex.en: Both sides agreed that the decision had been fair.
ex.cn: 双方都认为这个裁决是公正的。
ex.note: a fair price 公道的价格；fair weather 好天气

ex.en: The village fair is held on the first day of every month.
ex.cn: 乡村集市每个月的第一天举行。
ex.note: a trade fair 贸易博览会；the village fair 乡村集市

ex.en: He is widely called the father of modern Chinese physics.
ex.cn: 他被广泛称为中国现代物理学之父。
ex.note: the father of … …之父/创始人；a father of three 三个孩子的父亲

ex.en: The book is not a true story, but it is a moving piece of fiction.
ex.cn: 这本书不是真实的故事，却是一篇动人的小说。
ex.note: science fiction 科幻小说；in fiction 在小说中

ex.en: A red flag hung above the entrance of the hall.
ex.cn: 一面红旗悬在大厅入口上方。
ex.note: fly the flag 升旗；a warning flag 警告标志

ex.en: Only a fool would spend all his money on such a hat.
ex.cn: 只有傻瓜才会把钱全花在这种帽子上。
ex.note: make a fool of sb. 愚弄某人；a fool's errand 白费力气的差事

ex.en: The child was fooled by the trick seller in the market.
ex.cn: 那孩子在集市上被卖货的魔术师骗了。
ex.note: fool sb. into doing sth. 骗某人做某事

ex.en: The school was founded in 1958 and has grown steadily since.
ex.cn: 这所学校创办于1958年，此后一直在稳步发展。
ex.note: found a school / company 创办学校或公司；be founded on 建立在…之上

ex.en: The heavy rain frustrated all our plans for the picnic.
ex.cn: 大雨让我们的野餐计划全部落空。
ex.note: be frustrated by / at 因…而沮丧；frustrate sb.'s efforts 挫败某人的努力

ex.en: We stopped at the station to fill the tank with gas.
ex.cn: 我们在加油站停下，给油箱加了汽油。
ex.note: a gas burner 煤气炉；natural gas 天然气；a gas station 加油站

ex.en: Climate change is a global problem that no single country can solve.
ex.cn: 气候变化是任何单一国家都无法解决的全球性问题。
ex.note: global warming 全球变暖；a global view 全局观

ex.en: The sea gradually calmed down as the wind dropped.
ex.cn: 风势减弱，海面渐渐平静下来。
ex.note: gradually change 逐渐改变；gradually improve 逐渐好转

ex.en: The children sat on the ground and listened to the story.
ex.cn: 孩子们坐在地上听故事。
ex.note: on the ground 现场；the grounds for sth. …的理由

ex.en: She handled the difficult questions with great patience.
ex.cn: 她非常耐心地应对了那些棘手的问题。
ex.note: handle a crisis 应对危机；handle sth. carefully 小心处理

ex.en: Pull the handle gently to open the door.
ex.cn: 轻轻拉把手就能打开门。
ex.note: a door handle 门把手；get a handle on 掌握、驾驭

ex.en: The company's headquarters are in the centre of the city.
ex.cn: 这家公司的总部位于市中心。
ex.note: set up headquarters 设立总部；headquarters 作主语时谓语可用复数

ex.en: He hesitated at the door for a moment, then knocked.
ex.cn: 他在门口犹豫了一瞬，随后敲了门。
ex.note: hesitate to do sth. 犹豫着做某事；hesitate over / about 对…犹豫

ex.en: It is an honor to speak on behalf of the students.
ex.cn: 能代表学生发言是我的荣幸。
ex.note: an honor to sb. 对某人是荣幸；do sb. the honor of 给予某人…的礼遇

ex.en: The school honored the old teacher with a gold watch.
ex.cn: 学校赠给那位老教师一块金表以表敬意。
ex.note: honor sb. with sth. 以…向某人致敬

ex.en: His humorous stories always keep the children laughing.
ex.cn: 他那些幽默的故事总让孩子们笑个不停。
ex.note: a humorous writer 幽默的作家；in a humorous way 幽默地

ex.en: Children often confuse the imaginary animals in fairy tales with real ones.
ex.cn: 孩子们常把童话里想象出来的动物和真实动物混为一谈。
ex.note: an imaginary friend 想象中的朋友；imaginary fears 想象的恐惧

ex.en: The tour visits six cities, including two old ones on the coast.
ex.cn: 这次旅行会参观六座城市，其中包括两座海边古城。
ex.note: including 后接名词或动名词，一般不与 and 连用

ex.en: The inhabitants of the small island depend mainly on fishing.
ex.cn: 这座小岛的居民主要靠捕鱼为生。
ex.note: a local inhabitant 当地居民；the inhabitants of a forest 森林里的栖息动物

ex.en: The nurse checked every instrument before the operation.
ex.cn: 护士在手术前检查了每一件器械。
ex.note: a musical instrument 乐器；an instrument of … …的手段

ex.en: He invented a story to explain why he was late.
ex.cn: 他编了个故事来解释自己为什么迟到。
ex.note: invent a machine 发明机器；invent an excuse 编造借口

ex.en: She found a part-time job at a bookshop near the campus.
ex.cn: 她在校园附近一家书店找到了一份兼职。
ex.note: a full-time / part-time job 全职/兼职；do a good job 干得好

ex.en: The bag weighs two kilos and is easy to carry.
ex.cn: 这个包重两公斤，拎起来不费劲。
ex.note: kilo 是 kilogram 的口语缩写

ex.en: She walked down the narrow lane between the two rows of houses.
ex.cn: 她沿着两排房子之间的窄巷走下去。
ex.note: a country lane 乡间小路；swimming lanes 游泳道

ex.en: He leaned against the wall and watched the rain.
ex.cn: 他靠在墙上看着雨。
ex.note: lean against / on 倚靠；lean towards 倾向于

ex.en: The restaurant offers a lean meal for only ten yuan.
ex.cn: 这家餐厅只收十块钱，提供一份清淡的简餐。
ex.note: lean meat 瘦肉；a lean organization 精简的机构

ex.en: The dog licked the child's hand and wagged its tail.
ex.cn: 那条狗舔了舔孩子的手，摇着尾巴。
ex.note: lick one's lips 舔嘴唇；a lick of paint 一点油漆

ex.en: The whole family was gathered in the living-room that evening.
ex.cn: 那天晚上全家人都聚在起居室里。
ex.note: 也可写作 living room

ex.en: The old doctor has been loyal to his patients for forty years.
ex.cn: 那位老医生四十年来始终忠于自己的病人。
ex.note: be loyal to sb. 对某人忠诚；loyal support 忠实的支持

ex.en: Man has learned to travel far beyond the edge of his own world.
ex.cn: 人类早已学会远行，超出自己世界的边界。
ex.note: man and nature 人与自然；the man in the street 普通人

ex.en: The machine works at a maximum of forty coins a minute.
ex.cn: 这台机器的最高速度是每分钟四十枚硬币。
ex.note: a maximum of 最多；the maximum number 最大数目

ex.en: The maximum speed of the train is two hundred kilometres an hour.
ex.cn: 这列火车的最高时速是二百公里。
ex.note: maximum speed 最高速度；maximum score 最高分

ex.en: He mentioned the plan only once and never spoke of it again.
ex.cn: 他只提过一次那个计划，此后再没说起。
ex.note: mention doing 提到做过某事；not to mention 更不用说

ex.en: The Ministry of Education has published new guidelines for schools.
ex.cn: 教育部已经发布了新的学校指导纲要。
ex.note: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs 外交部

ex.en: A monkey in the zoo took the visitor's hat and ran off with it.
ex.cn: 动物园里一只猴子叼走了游客的帽子就跑掉了。
ex.note: to monkey about 瞎闹；a monkey on your back 缠人的负担

ex.en: The new machine can handle multiple tasks at the same time.
ex.cn: 这台新机器能同时处理多项任务。
ex.note: multiple choice 多项选择；multiple causes 多方面的原因

ex.en: Twelve is a multiple of three, so the coins can be split evenly.
ex.cn: 十二是三的倍数，所以这些硬币可以平均分。
ex.note: a multiple of … …的倍数；common multiples 公倍数

ex.en: There is a small hospital nearby if you need help.
ex.cn: 附近有一家小医院，需要帮助的话可以去。
ex.note: live nearby 住在附近；nearby shops 附近的商店

ex.en: His niece spent the whole afternoon on his shoulders.
ex.cn: 他的小侄女整个下午都骑在他的肩上。
ex.note: niece 侄女/外甥女；nephew 侄子/外甥

ex.en: He had a clear notion of what he wanted to build.
ex.cn: 对自己想造什么，他心里有清楚的构想。
ex.note: the notion that … …这种观念；have a notion 有一个想法

ex.en: Every occupation has its own language and its own rhythm.
ex.cn: 每一种职业都有自己的语言和节奏。
ex.note: a full-time occupation 全职职业；an occupation of mind 脑力劳动

ex.en: The factory has an opening for an engineer with two years' experience.
ex.cn: 这家工厂有一个空缺职位，需要一位有两年经验的工程师。
ex.note: an opening for 职位空缺；the opening of … …的开始

ex.en: The opening ceremony of the club fair lasted only half an hour.
ex.cn: 社团招新的开幕典礼只持续了半个小时。
ex.note: the opening hours 营业时间；an opening remark 开场白

ex.en: He bought a piece of cake that weighed about an ounce.
ex.cn: 他买了一块大约一盎司重的蛋糕。
ex.note: an ounce of 一点点；weigh like an ounce 轻如鸿毛

ex.en: An old ox pulled the cart slowly along the village road.
ex.cn: 一头老牛沿着乡间小路慢慢地拉着车。
ex.note: an ox 一头牛；plow with oxen 牛耕

ex.en: The old parliament building is now a museum for visitors.
ex.cn: 那座古老的议会大厦如今成了供人参观的博物馆。
ex.note: the 模拟议会 模拟议会；parliament members 议员

ex.en: For the sake of peace, both sides agreed to sit down and talk.
ex.cn: 为了和平，双方同意坐下来谈一谈。
ex.note: at peace with 与…和睦；in peace 平安地

ex.en: He is one of the kindest persons I have ever met.
ex.cn: 他是我见过的最和善的人之一。
ex.note: in person 亲自；the third person 第三人称

ex.en: There was a pile of old magazines on the corner of the desk.
ex.cn: 桌角上堆着一摞旧杂志。
ex.note: a pile of 一堆；a pile of work 大量的活儿

ex.en: Autumn leaves piled up against the wall of the old house.
ex.cn: 秋叶堆在老屋的墙根下。
ex.note: pile up 堆积起来；pile sth. with… 用…堆满…

ex.en: The film has a thin plot but a wonderful cast.
ex.cn: 这部电影情节单薄，却阵容强大。
ex.note: the plot of a novel 小说情节；a plot to kill … 谋杀…的阴谋

ex.en: Two members plotted against the new rule behind the scenes.
ex.cn: 两名成员在背后密谋反对新规定。
ex.note: plot against 密谋反对；plot sth. on a chart 在图上绘制

ex.en: The population of the town has doubled since the new road was built.
ex.cn: 新路修好以后，这座城镇的人口翻了一番。
ex.note: the population of 某地的人口；a growing population 不断增长的人口

ex.en: The machine is not beautiful, but it is practical and it works.
ex.cn: 这台机器不好看，但很实用，而且真管用。
ex.note: practical advice 实用的建议；take a practical approach 采取务实的做法

ex.en: The price of the cake made him laugh out loud.
ex.cn: 蛋糕的价钱让他放声笑了出来。
ex.note: at a price of 以…的价格；pay the price 付出代价

ex.en: The shop priced the second-hand bikes at half their original value.
ex.cn: 这家店把二手自行车定价为原值的一半。
ex.note: price sth. at sth. 把某物定在某个价钱

ex.en: It was a professional performance from beginning to end.
ex.cn: 从头到尾都是专业的表演。
ex.note: professional skills 专业技能；a professional attitude 专业的态度

ex.en: He talked to a professional about the pain in his shoulder.
ex.cn: 他找了一位专业人员询问肩膀的疼痛。
ex.note: a health professional 医疗专业人员；professional help 专业帮助

ex.en: Students from every province came to join the debate.
ex.cn: 各个省的学生都来参加辩论。
ex.note: province 省份；a province of knowledge 知识的一个领域

ex.en: The two neighbors quarreled about a broken fence for a whole afternoon.
ex.cn: 两个邻居为一段坏篱笆吵了整个下午。
ex.note: quarrel with sb. about sth. 因某事与某人争吵；quarrel over 为…争吵

ex.en: A white rat ran across the floor and hid behind the box.
ex.cn: 一只白鼠跑过地板，躲到了箱子后面。
ex.note: a lab rat 实验用老鼠；smell a rat 察觉不对劲

ex.en: Many small shops closed during the long recession.
ex.cn: 在那场漫长的经济衰退中，许多小店倒闭了。
ex.note: during / in a recession 在经济衰退期间

ex.en: He regretted losing his temper in front of so many people.
ex.cn: 他后悔在那么多人面前发了脾气。
ex.note: regret doing sth. 后悔做某事；to my regret 让我遗憾的是

ex.en: I am going to renew my membership in the English club.
ex.cn: 我打算续订英语俱乐部的会员资格。
ex.note: renew a membership 续订会员；renew one's strength 恢复体力

ex.en: The coast is a popular resort in summer.
ex.cn: 海边是夏天很受欢迎的度假胜地。
ex.note: a seaside resort 海滨度假胜地；as a last resort 作为最后手段

ex.en: When words failed, he resorted to action.
ex.cn: 言语无济于事时，他就诉诸行动。
ex.note: resort to violence 诉诸暴力；resort to doing 采取…这种手段

ex.en: The valley has rich soil, and the farmers grow excellent vegetables there.
ex.cn: 山谷里土壤肥沃，农民在那里种出很好的蔬菜。
ex.note: be rich in 富含；a rich country 富裕的国家

ex.en: The workers rotate the position every two hours.
ex.cn: 工人们每两小时轮换一次岗位。
ex.note: rotate crops 轮作；rotate A and B 轮流做A和B

ex.en: For the sake of peace, both sides agreed to talk again.
ex.cn: 为了和平，双方同意再谈一次。
ex.note: for the sake of 为了…；for safety's sake 为了安全起见

ex.en: He scattered the seeds over the empty flower bed.
ex.cn: 他把种子撒在空着的花坛里。
ex.note: scatter sth. over sth. 把…撒在…上；scatter the crowd 驱散人群

ex.en: The club secretary keeps the list of members and the fee records.
ex.cn: 社团干事保管着社员名单和会费记录。
ex.note: a club secretary 社团干事；the secretary of state 国务卿

ex.en: Volunteers served tea and cakes to the visitors all afternoon.
ex.cn: 志愿者整个下午都在给来客端茶送糕点。
ex.note: serve sb. sth. 给某人端上某物；serve as 担任；serve to 符合

ex.en: We found shelter under a wide tree when the storm broke.
ex.cn: 暴风雨来临时，我们在一棵大树下找到了避身处。
ex.note: seek / take shelter 寻求/躲进庇护；a shelter for the homeless 无家可归者收容所

ex.en: The old barn sheltered them from the heavy rain.
ex.cn: 那座旧谷棚替他们挡住了大雨。
ex.note: shelter sb. from sth. 为某人遮蔽某物；shelter in a place 躲在某处

ex.en: There was no sign of life in the empty house.
ex.cn: 那间空房子里毫无生气。
ex.note: no sign of 没有…的迹象；a road sign 路标

ex.en: Please sign your name at the bottom of the form.
ex.cn: 请在表格下方签上你的名字。
ex.note: sign an agreement 签署协议；sign up for 报名参加

ex.en: The children skated happily across the frozen pond.
ex.cn: 孩子们在结冰的池塘上快乐地滑着冰。
ex.note: skate on ice 滑冰；go skating 去滑冰

ex.en: A pair of old skates hung by the door.
ex.cn: 一双旧冰鞋挂在门边。
ex.note: a pair of skates 一双冰鞋；roller skates 轮滑鞋

ex.en: We bought some snacks and ate them under the trees.
ex.cn: 我们买了一些小吃，在树下吃着。
ex.note: have a snack 吃点零食；a snack bar 小吃店

ex.en: Sometimes he walks to the library instead of taking the bus.
ex.cn: 他有时会走去图书馆，而不坐公交车。
ex.note: sometimes and other times 时不时地

ex.en: Many species of birds return to this lake every spring.
ex.cn: 许多种候鸟每年春天都会回到这个湖上。
ex.note: a species of … 一种…；endangered species 濒危物种

ex.en: The gardener sprayed the young trees with water.
ex.cn: 园丁给小树喷了水。
ex.note: spray sth. with sth. 用…喷…；spray paint 喷漆

ex.en: A fine spray of water came from the broken pipe.
ex.cn: 破裂的管子喷出一阵细密的水雾。
ex.note: a spray of rain 一阵雨；sea spray 海浪的水花

ex.en: Someone tried to steal the biscuits while the volunteer was looking away.
ex.cn: 志愿者一转身，就有人想偷饼干。
ex.note: steal sth. from sb. 从某人那里偷走某物；steal a glance 瞥一眼

ex.en: The strap of his bag broke halfway down the road.
ex.cn: 他的包带在走到半路时断了。
ex.note: a shoulder strap 背带；a watch strap 表带

ex.en: You can use yogurt as a substitute for cream in this recipe.
ex.cn: 在这个食谱里，你可以用酸奶代替奶油。
ex.note: a substitute for … …的替代品；a substitute teacher 代课老师

ex.en: We substituted honey for sugar because no sugar was left.
ex.cn: 因为没有糖了，我们用蜂蜜代替。
ex.note: substitute A for B 用A代替B

ex.en: A thin line of sunshine appeared above the roofs.
ex.cn: 屋顶上方出现了一道细细的阳光。
ex.note: a ray of sunshine 一缕阳光；in the sunshine 在阳光下

ex.en: She pulled her sweater around her shoulders and went out.
ex.cn: 她把毛衣裹紧在肩上，走了出去。
ex.note: a woollen sweater 羊毛衫；pull one's sweater around one 把毛衣裹在身上

ex.en: The task looks simple, but it takes practice to do it well.
ex.cn: 这件事看起来简单，但要做得好得靠练习。
ex.note: a difficult task 艰巨的任务；a routine task 日常任务

ex.en: The atmosphere in the hall grew tense as the vote was counted.
ex.cn: 计票的时候，大厅里的气氛变得紧张起来。
ex.note: a tense moment 紧张的时刻；the tense situation 紧张的局面

ex.en: Change the verb into the past tense in this sentence.
ex.cn: 把这句话里的动词改成过去时。
ex.note: past / present / future tense 过去时/现在时/将来时

ex.en: These are the tools you need for the experiment.
ex.cn: 这些就是你做实验需要的工具。
ex.note: these 与 those 相对，用于指示近处的人或物

ex.en: We heard thunder rolling over the river.
ex.cn: 我们听见雷声在河面上隆隆滚过。
ex.note: thunder and lightning 雷电；a thunder of applause 雷鸣般的掌声

ex.en: It thundered all night and the windows shook.
ex.cn: 整夜雷声隆隆，窗户都在震动。
ex.note: it thunders 打雷；thunder against 猛击

ex.en: A good leader has to tolerate disagreement without anger.
ex.cn: 好的领导者必须能容忍分歧而不动怒。
ex.note: tolerate sth. 容忍某事；cannot tolerate 无法忍受

ex.en: The play ends with a tragedy that somehow turns into peace.
ex.cn: 这出戏以一场悲剧收场，却又奇异地化为了平和。
ex.note: a Greek tragedy 希腊悲剧；a personal tragedy 人生悲剧

ex.en: The club is planning a trip to the coast next spring.
ex.cn: 社团正在筹划明年春天去海边的旅行。
ex.note: a day trip 一日游；go on a trip 去旅行

ex.en: He tripped over a loose stone and dropped the basket.
ex.cn: 他被一块松动的石头绊倒，手里的篮子摔了出去。
ex.note: trip over 被…绊倒；trip up 使出错

ex.en: A bicycle tyre hisses when it hits a sharp stone.
ex.cn: 自行车轮胎撞上尖石时会发出嘶的一声。
ex.note: a flat tyre 瘪了的轮胎；a spare tyre 备胎

ex.en: Nothing will change unless someone is willing to act.
ex.cn: 除非有人愿意行动，否则什么都不会改变。
ex.note: unless = if…not，引导否定条件句

ex.en: Without a pump, the bottle cannot keep a vacuum inside it.
ex.cn: 没有抽气泵，瓶子里不可能保持真空。
ex.note: a vacuum 真空；a vacuum in the market 市场真空

ex.en: She vacuumed the living-room before the guests arrived.
ex.cn: 客人们到来之前，她用吸尘器把起居室打扫了一遍。
ex.note: vacuum the floor 给地板吸尘

ex.en: Every viewer of the film was moved by the last scene.
ex.cn: 每一位看这部电影的观众都被最后一幕打动了。
ex.note: a television viewer 电视观众；viewers of the art show 艺术展的观众

ex.en: The motion was passed by a single vote.
ex.cn: 这项动议以一票之差获得通过。
ex.note: vote for / against 支持/反对；put sth. to the vote 将某事付诸表决

ex.en: The wealthy may keep their wealth, but they cannot buy good health.
ex.cn: 富人或许能保住财富，却买不到健康。
ex.note: a wealthy family 富裕的家庭；the wealthy 富人

ex.en: Whenever he feels far from home, he writes a long letter.
ex.cn: 每当觉得离乡太远，他就会写一封长信。
ex.note: whenever + 从句 每当…；no matter whenever 无论何时

ex.en: She leaned against the window and watched the rain fall.
ex.cn: 她倚着窗户，看着雨落下来。
ex.note: at the window 在窗前；a service window 业务窗口

ex.en: Don't worry about the exam; just do your best.
ex.cn: 别为考试担心，尽力就好。
ex.note: worry about 担心…；worry oneself 操心

ex.en: He worried about his cousin for a moment, and then let it go.
ex.cn: 他为表妹担心了一会儿，随后就放下了。
ex.note: no worries 没什么好担心的；deep worries 深切的忧虑

ex.en: The young man in the blue coat introduced himself to the group.
ex.cn: 那个穿蓝外套的年轻男子向众人作了自我介绍。
ex.note: young people 年轻人；too young for sth. 对…来说太年轻
